title: NEXEN: USD settlement batch release failing

personas.role: Incident commander; head of settlement operations for NEXEN custody. Calm, time-boxed, thinks in cutoffs and client impact.
On-call engineer for the NEXEN web platform. Owns the Transactions screen and the release pipeline.
Client service manager for institutional custody clients. Fields client calls, needs a plain-language status.

script.text: declaring sev1. USD settlement batch SB-20260918-USD won't release from NEXEN Transactions, every attempt fails. 4 instructions queued, 16:00 ET cutoff.
ABC Global Investors' ops desk just called, they're waiting on the Siemens and Vodafone receipts. what can I tell them?
{sre_bot} can you take this? start from the alert in #pershing-access-alerts and Datadog. I need cause, blast radius, and whether we roll back or forward-fix.
nothing deployed on the settlement gateway today. the only NEXEN change this week was the new Settlement Batch panel on Transactions
holding line for ABC: release delayed, no instructions have left NEXEN, next update in 30 min. ok to send?
send it. Daniel, can you confirm with SRE Bot whether this is the panel change before anyone rolls back
{sre_bot} once you have the root cause, is the fix PR ready to review? I'll take it
thanks all. forward-fix once the PR is reviewed, no rollback. {sre_bot} please draft the RCA from our template when the fix is in
